en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph of a man dressed in medieval chainmail armor with a crown or circlet, holding a sword in both hands and gazing upwards with a solemn expression. There is a small embossed or printed text in the lower right-hand corner of the card that reads 'BRUNO WIESE DRESDEN.' The overall style is dramatic and evocative of historical or theatrical portraits.
